current_official_findings.verified: WCS retrieval chain is GetCapabilities, DescribeCoverage, then GetCoverage; GetCapabilities provides offered coverages and service capabilities, DescribeCoverage provides details for selected coverage identifiers, and GetCoverage retrieves selected coverage values.
Government resource record remains active and was last updated 1 August 2025; it links the current Environment Agency DTM 1m WCS resource.

Survey data uses OSGB36 British National Grid and elevations above Ordnance Datum Newlyn; Composite uses OSTN15, while Time Stamped/point-cloud geoid must be read from survey metadata and post-26-Aug-2016 surveys use OSGM15.
INSPIRE polygons remain indicative extent/position, have unique Land Registry INSPIRE IDs, and are refreshed monthly.
WMS Preview is only an image and cannot be queried; it must not be used as numeric elevation evidence.
